title: "Drug Use and MDE Across All Ages (Weighted Analysis)"

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

# Load required packages
library(tidyverse)
library(survey)
library(gtsummary)
library(summarytools)
library(dtplyr)  # For efficient data.table-backed dplyr operations
library(kableExtra)  # For enhanced table formatting
library(broom)  # For tidying model outputs

# Load the dataset (ensure NSDUH_2023.Rdata is in your working directory)
load("NSDUH_2023.Rdata")

# Create a copy of the dataset
d <- data
```

```{r functions}
# Function to create composite drug use variables
create_composite <- function(data, vars, name) {
  data %>%
    mutate(
      !!sym(name) := case_when(
        if_any(all_of(vars), ~ . == 1) ~ 1,
        if_all(all_of(vars), ~ . == 0) ~ 0,
        TRUE ~ NA_real_
      )
    )
}

# Function to compute minimum age at first use for a set of drugs
compute_min_age <- function(data, age_vars, name) {
  data %>%
    mutate(
      !!sym(name) := pmin(!!!syms(age_vars), na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      !!sym(name) := if_else(is.infinite(!!sym(name)), NA_real_, !!sym(name))
    )
}
```

```{r data_preparation}
# Select relevant variables (using dtplyr for efficiency)
s <- d %>% 
  lazy_dt() %>% 
  select(
    # Core IDs & Weights
    QUESTID2, VEREP, VESTR_C, ANALWT2_C,
    
    # Demographics / Confounders
    AGE3, CATAG2, IRSEX, NEWRACE2, EDUSCHGRD2, EDUHIGHCAT, POVERTY3,
    
    # Drug Variables (Exposures)
    CIGFLAG, CGRFLAG, PIPFLAG, SMKLSSFLAG, NICVAPFLAG, ALCFLAG, CBDHMPFLAG, 
    MRJFLAG, COCFLAG, CRKFLAG, HERFLAG, HALLUCFLAG, INHALFLAG, METHAMFLAG, 
    PNRANYFLAG, TRQANYFLAG, STMANYFLAG, SEDANYFLAG,
    
    # Age at First Use Variables
    IRCIGAGE, IRNICVAPAGE, IRSMKLSSTRY, IRCGRAGE, IRALCAGE, IRMJAGE,  # Soft drugs
    IRCOCAGE, IRHERAGE, IRMETHAMAGE, IRHALLUCAGE, IRLSDAGE, IRECSTMOAGE,  # Hard drugs
    
    # Outcome Variables
    YMDELT, AMDELT, YMDEAUD5YR, YMIUD5YANY, YMSUD5YANY, 
    
    # Other Covariates
    AVGGRADE, PARLMTSN
  ) %>% 
  as_tibble()

# Define drug variable lists
all_drug_vars <- c("CIGFLAG", "CGRFLAG", "PIPFLAG", "SMKLSSFLAG", "NICVAPFLAG", 
                   "ALCFLAG", "CBDHMPFLAG", "MRJFLAG", "COCFLAG", "CRKFLAG", 
                   "HERFLAG", "HALLUCFLAG", "INHALFLAG", "METHAMFLAG", 
                   "PNRANYFLAG", "TRQANYFLAG", "STMANYFLAG", "SEDANYFLAG")

soft_drug_vars <- c("CIGFLAG", "CGRFLAG", "PIPFLAG", "SMKLSSFLAG", 
                    "NICVAPFLAG", "ALCFLAG", "CBDHMPFLAG", "MRJFLAG")

hard_drug_vars <- c("COCFLAG", "CRKFLAG", "HERFLAG", "HALLUCFLAG", 
                    "INHALFLAG", "METHAMFLAG", "PNRANYFLAG", "TRQANYFLAG", 
                    "STMANYFLAG", "SEDANYFLAG")

# Define age at first use lists
soft_age_vars <- c("IRCIGAGE", "IRNICVAPAGE", "IRSMKLSSTRY", "IRCGRAGE", "IRALCAGE", "IRMJAGE")
hard_age_vars <- c("IRCOCAGE", "IRHERAGE", "IRMETHAMAGE", "IRHALLUCAGE", "IRLSDAGE", "IRECSTMOAGE")

# Create composite variables using the function
s_clean <- s %>%
  create_composite(all_drug_vars, "any_drug_ever_used") %>%
  create_composite(soft_drug_vars, "any_soft_drug_ever_used") %>%
  create_composite(hard_drug_vars, "any_hard_drug_ever_used") %>%
  compute_min_age(soft_age_vars, "min_age_soft") %>%
  compute_min_age(hard_age_vars, "min_age_hard")

# Preview the composite variables
glimpse(s_clean %>% select(any_drug_ever_used, any_soft_drug_ever_used, any_hard_drug_ever_used, min_age_soft, min_age_hard))

# Define confounders
confounder_vars <- c("CATAG2", "IRSEX", "NEWRACE2", "EDUHIGHCAT", "POVERTY3")

# Prepare analytic dataset for all ages
analytic <- s_clean %>%
  
  # Recode variables
  mutate(
    # Recode outcome: Major Depressive Episode (MDE)
    YMDELT_factor = factor(YMDELT, 
                           levels = c(1, 2), 
                           labels = c("Yes", "No")),
    
    # Combined MDE for all ages
    MDE_combined = if_else(CATAG2 == 1, YMDELT, AMDELT),
    MDE_combined_factor = factor(MDE_combined, 
                                 levels = c(1, 2), 
                                 labels = c("Yes", "No")),
    
    # Recode demographics
    CATAG2 = factor(CATAG2, 
                    levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6), 
                    labels = c("12-17", "18-25", "26-34", "35-49", "50-64", "65+")),

    IRSEX = factor(IRSEX, 
                   levels = c(1, 2), 
                   labels = c("Male", "Female")),
    
    any_drug_ever_used_factor = factor(any_drug_ever_used, 
                                       levels = c(0, 1), 
                                       labels = c("Never Used", "Ever Used")),
    
    # New composites for soft and hard
    any_soft_drug_ever_used_factor = factor(any_soft_drug_ever_used, 
                                            levels = c(0, 1), 
                                            labels = c("Never Used", "Ever Used")),
    
    any_hard_drug_ever_used_factor = factor(any_hard_drug_ever_used, 
                                            levels = c(0, 1), 
                                            labels = c("Never Used", "Ever Used")),
    
    # Combined drug type variable
    drug_type = case_when(
      any_soft_drug_ever_used == 1 & any_hard_drug_ever_used == 0 ~ "Soft Only",
      any_hard_drug_ever_used == 1 & any_soft_drug_ever_used == 0 ~ "Hard Only",
      any_soft_drug_ever_used == 1 & any_hard_drug_ever_used == 1 ~ "Both",
      any_soft_drug_ever_used == 0 & any_hard_drug_ever_used == 0 ~ "None",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ) %>%
      factor(levels = c("None", "Soft Only", "Hard Only", "Both"), ordered = FALSE)
  ) %>%
  
  # List-wise deletion: remove NAs in outcome, exposures, drug_type, and confounders
  drop_na(MDE_combined_factor, any_drug_ever_used_factor, any_soft_drug_ever_used_factor, 
          any_hard_drug_ever_used_factor, drug_type, all_of(confounder_vars))

# Report dropped rows
original_rows <- nrow(s_clean)
final_rows <- nrow(analytic)
cat("Dropped", original_rows - final_rows, "rows due to NAs (out of", original_rows, "total rows).\n")

# Check sample sizes and distributions (unweighted)
cat("--- Unweighted Age Distribution ---\n")
print(freq(analytic$CATAG2))

cat("\n--- Unweighted Any Drug Use Distribution ---\n")
print(freq(analytic$any_drug_ever_used_factor))

cat("\n--- Unweighted Soft Drug Use Distribution ---\n")
print(freq(analytic$any_soft_drug_ever_used_factor))

cat("\n--- Unweighted Hard Drug Use Distribution ---\n")
print(freq(analytic$any_hard_drug_ever_used_factor))

cat("\n--- Unweighted Drug Type Distribution ---\n")
print(freq(analytic$drug_type))

cat("\n--- Unweighted Depression Outcome Distribution ---\n")
print(freq(analytic$MDE_combined_factor))

# Summary of age at first use
cat("\n--- Summary of Min Age at First Soft Drug Use (among users) ---\n")
analytic %>% filter(any_soft_drug_ever_used == 1) %>% select(min_age_soft) %>% summary()

cat("\n--- Summary of Min Age at First Hard Drug Use (among users) ---\n")
analytic %>% filter(any_hard_drug_ever_used == 1) %>% select(min_age_hard) %>% summary()
```

```{r survey_design}
# Create survey design object
svy_analytic <- svydesign(
  id      = ~VEREP,
  strata  = ~VESTR_C,
  weights = ~ANALWT2_C,
  data    = analytic,
  nest    = TRUE
)

# Print survey design summary
print(svy_analytic)
```

```{r table1}
# Define variable labels
var_labels <- list(
  CATAG2 ~ "Age Group",
  IRSEX ~ "Sex",
  NEWRACE2 ~ "Race/Ethnicity",
  EDUHIGHCAT ~ "Education",
  POVERTY3 ~ "Poverty Level",
  any_drug_ever_used_factor ~ "Any Drug Use (Ever)",
  any_soft_drug_ever_used_factor ~ "Soft Drug Use (Ever)",
  any_hard_drug_ever_used_factor ~ "Hard Drug Use (Ever)",
  drug_type ~ "Drug Type Category",
  min_age_soft ~ "Min Age at First Soft Drug Use",
  min_age_hard ~ "Min Age at First Hard Drug Use"
)

# Generate weighted Table 1 stratified by outcome
table1 <- svy_analytic %>%
  tbl_svysummary(
    by = MDE_combined_factor,
    include = c(CATAG2, IRSEX, NEWRACE2, EDUHIGHCAT, POVERTY3, any_drug_ever_used_factor, any_soft_drug_ever_used_factor, 
                any_hard_drug_ever_used_factor, drug_type, min_age_soft, min_age_hard),
    label = var_labels,
    statistic = list(all_categorical() ~ "{n_unweighted} ({p}%)", all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})")
  ) %>%
  add_overall(
    col_label = "**Overall (N = {N_unweighted})**",
    statistic = list(all_categorical() ~ "{n_unweighted} ({p}%)", all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})")
  ) %>%
  add_p() %>%
  modify_header(label = "**Characteristic**") %>%
  bold_labels()

# Display the table with kableExtra for better formatting
table1 %>%
  as_kable() %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)

# Export table to CSV
write.csv(table1$table_body, "table1_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r confounder_tests}
# Define variables for testing
outcome_var <- "MDE_combined_factor"
all_exposures <- c("any_drug_ever_used_factor", "any_soft_drug_ever_used_factor", "any_hard_drug_ever_used_factor")
confounders_to_test <- c("CATAG2", "IRSEX", "NEWRACE2", "EDUHIGHCAT", "POVERTY3")

# Function to safely run svychisq and handle errors
safe_svychisq <- function(formula, design) {
  tryCatch({
    svychisq(formula, design = design)
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Error in svychisq for ", deparse(formula), ": ", e$message)
    return(NULL)
  })
}

# Test confounders vs. outcome
cat("--- Confounder vs. Outcome (Depression) Tests ---\n")
conf_outcome_tests <- lapply(confounders_to_test, function(conf) {
  formula <- as.formula(paste("~", conf, "+", outcome_var))
  safe_svychisq(formula, svy_analytic)
})
names(conf_outcome_tests) <- confounders_to_test
print(conf_outcome_tests)

# Test confounders vs. each exposure
for (exp in all_exposures) {
  cat("\n\n--- Confounder vs.", exp, "Tests ---\n")
  conf_exposure_tests <- lapply(confounders_to_test, function(conf) {
    formula <- as.formula(paste("~", conf, "+", exp))
    safe_svychisq(formula, svy_analytic)
  })
  names(conf_exposure_tests) <- confounders_to_test
  print(conf_exposure_tests)
}

# Test confounders vs. drug_type
cat("\n\n--- Confounder vs. Drug Type Tests ---\n")
drug_type_tests <- lapply(confounders_to_test, function(conf) {
  formula <- as.formula(paste("~", conf, "+", "drug_type"))
  safe_svychisq(formula, svy_analytic)
})
names(drug_type_tests) <- confounders_to_test
print(drug_type_tests)
```

```{r logistic_regression}
# Function to fit and summarize weighted logistic regression
fit_logistic <- function(exposure, confounders, design) {
  formula <- as.formula(paste(outcome_var, "~", exposure, "+", paste(confounders, collapse = " + ")))
  model <- svyglm(formula, design = design, family = quasibinomial())
  tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE)  # Odds ratios with CIs
}

# Fit models for each exposure
models <- list()
for (exp in all_exposures) {
  cat("\n\n--- Logistic Regression for", exp, "vs. MDE ---\n")
  models[[exp]] <- fit_logistic(exp, confounders_to_test, svy_analytic)
  print(models[[exp]])
}

# Fit combined model with drug_type as predictor
cat("\n\n--- Logistic Regression for Drug Type Category vs. MDE ---\n")
drug_type_model <- fit_logistic("drug_type", confounders_to_test, svy_analytic)
print(drug_type_model)

# New: Models including age at first use
cat("\n\n--- Logistic Regression for Soft Drug Use + Min Age at First Soft Use vs. MDE ---\n")
soft_age_model <- fit_logistic(c("any_soft_drug_ever_used_factor", "min_age_soft"), confounders_to_test, svy_analytic)
print(soft_age_model)

cat("\n\n--- Logistic Regression for Hard Drug Use + Min Age at First Hard Use vs. MDE ---\n")
hard_age_model <- fit_logistic(c("any_hard_drug_ever_used_factor", "min_age_hard"), confounders_to_test, svy_analytic)
print(hard_age_model)

# Export model results
for (exp in names(models)) {
  write.csv(models[[exp]], paste0("logistic_", exp, "_results.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
}
write.csv(drug_type_model, "logistic_drug_type_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(soft_age_model, "logistic_soft_age_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(hard_age_model, "logistic_hard_age_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
```{r mediation analysis}

# Subset to respondents who have used both soft and hard drugs (for sequence analysis)
mediation_data <- analytic %>%
  filter(any_soft_drug_ever_used == 1 & any_hard_drug_ever_used == 1)

svy_mediation <- svydesign(
  id = ~VEREP, strata = ~VESTR_C, weights = ~ANALWT2_C, data = mediation_data,  nest = TRUE 
)

# Step 1: Soft age -> Hard age (does earlier soft drug use predict earlier hard drug use?)
step1 <- svyglm(min_age_hard ~ min_age_soft, design = svy_mediation)
print("Step 1: Soft Age -> Hard Age")
print(tidy(step1, conf.int = TRUE))

# Step 2: Hard age -> MDE (does earlier hard drug use predict higher MDE odds?)
step2 <- svyglm(MDE_combined_factor ~ min_age_hard, design = svy_mediation, family = quasibinomial())
print("Step 2: Hard Age -> MDE")
print(tidy(step2, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE))

# Step 3: Soft age -> MDE (does earlier soft drug use predict higher MDE odds?)
step3 <- svyglm(MDE_combined_factor ~ min_age_soft, design = svy_mediation, family = quasibinomial())
print("Step 3: Soft Age -> MDE")
print(tidy(step3, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE))

# Step 4: Soft age + Hard age -> MDE (mediation test: does hard age reduce soft age effect?)
step4 <- svyglm(MDE_combined_factor ~ min_age_soft + min_age_hard, design = svy_mediation, family = quasibinomial())
print("Step 4: Soft Age + Hard Age -> MDE (Mediation Check)")
print(tidy(step4, conf.int = TRUE, exponentiate = TRUE))

# Interpretation helper
cat("\nMediation Interpretation:\n")
cat("- If Step 1 shows min_age_soft predicts min_age_hard (e.g., coeff < 0: earlier soft = earlier hard),\n")
cat("- Step 2 shows min_age_hard predicts MDE (e.g., coeff < 0: earlier hard = higher MDE odds),\n")
cat("- Step 3 shows min_age_soft predicts MDE,\n")
cat("- And in Step 4, min_age_soft effect weakens (closer to 0), mediation is suggested.\n")
```

```{r interpretation}
# Interpretation Section
cat("## Results Interpretation\n\n")
cat("### Table 1:\n")
cat("- This table shows weighted distributions of characteristics stratified by MDE status across all ages, including drug type and age at first use.\n")
cat("- Significant p-values indicate differences between groups (e.g., earlier age at first use in MDE cases).\n\n")

cat("### Confounder Tests:\n")
cat("- Chi-square tests assess associations between confounders and outcome/exposures/drug type.\n")
cat("- Significant results suggest potential confounding (adjust for these in models).\n\n")

cat("### Logistic Regression:\n")
cat("- Models estimate adjusted odds ratios (OR) for MDE by drug use type.\n")
cat("- OR > 1 indicates increased MDE risk; 95% CI not crossing 1 means statistical significance.\n")
cat("- New models include age at first use: Earlier initiation may predict higher MDE odds.\n")
cat("- For example, younger age at first soft/hard use could increase risk.\n\n")

cat("### Mediation Analysis:\n")
cat("- Examines if age of first soft drug use affects age of first hard drug use, and if hard drug use age mediates the relationship to MDE.\n")
cat("- Based on cross-sectional data; causality cannot be inferred.\n")
cat("- If earlier soft drug use predicts earlier hard drug use, and earlier hard drug use predicts higher MDE odds, with mediation indicated by attenuation of soft drug effect when controlling for hard drug age.\n\n")

cat("### Notes:\n")
cat("- Analysis uses survey weights for national representativeness.\n")
cat("- Missing data handled via list-wise deletion (", original_rows - final_rows, " rows dropped).\n")
cat("- Age at first use is min across drugs; only computed for users.\n")
cat("- MDE combines youth and adult lifetime measures.\n")
cat("- Consider multiple imputation for future robustness.\n")
```
